description: Registered exemptions for the silent-success gates (#1982). Direction is shrink-only: entries come out as the debt is paid, and are never added to wave a new violation through. There is deliberately no --update writer. Populated from a full `bun tests/run-tests.ts -P 4` census in report mode on 2026-08-20 (1068 files: zero zero-assertion violations, zero process leaks, 14 self-skipped testcases). See docs/reference/09-testing.md.
